admission.justification: A cancelled unpublished direct-landing generation left terminal would strand the request; the check keeps the plain retry workable.

applicability: Repeated direct-landing publication attempts of one admitted request.
conditions: The refusals happen before ref publication, so no published generation exists.
exclusions: A publication that reached the ref; that generation stays recoverable instead of being replaced.
statement: Repeated refused publications of the same direct-landing request cancel unpublished generations and the next plain retry can land.
